versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Claude API skill for building LLM-powered applications:

- Provides guidance for integrating with the Claude API, Anthropic SDKs, and Agent SDK across multiple languages.
- Outlines default settings: Claude Opus 4.6 model, adaptive thinking, and streaming for long tasks.
- Adds robust language detection with a fallback and decision tree to help pick the right examples.
- Includes detailed tables to clarify SDK feature support and guide users to the recommended APIs for different use cases.
- Offers advice on when to use agents, workflows, or single API calls based on application needs.
